description: This file implements the DefaultJwtValidator class responsible for validating JSON Web Tokens (JWT) using a provided public key. It fetches the appropriate public key for a given issuer and key ID, then attempts to validate the token, handling errors gracefully.

classes.name: DefaultJwtValidator
classes.description: Final class implementing JwtValidator that validates JSON Web Tokens using specified public keys. It provides static factory method for creation and methods for token validation with error handling.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate DefaultJwtValidator with a given PublicKeyProvider.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the provided JsonWebToken asynchronously by retrieving the correct public key and attempting signature verification.

methods.name: tryToValidateWithPublicKey
methods.description: Attempts to validate the JWT with the provided public key, catching and logging exceptions if validation fails.

methods.name: validateWithPublicKey
methods.description: Performs actual validation of the JWT signature using the provided public key, utilizing the Jwts parser.
